### Observed differences

- In the later window, four activities that were absent before — A14, A15, A20 and A21 — appear in about 30%, 26%, 21% and 23% of traces respectively, each occurring at most once per trace and never together with each other. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL006, REL007, REL010]
- In the later window, A37 no longer leads directly to A22. Before, A37 went to A22 in every case; after, A37's outgoing transitions are split among A14, A15, A20 and A21, and each of these new activities leads to A22. [DIR005, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, REL004, REL005, REL008, REL009, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014]
- The distance between A37 and A22 grew from one step to two steps. [LAG001]
- A22's position shifted slightly later in the trace (mean from about 0.38 to 0.40). [POS005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that a new step was inserted between A37 and A22 in the later window, choosing one of four alternative activities (A14, A15, A20 or A21). The supporting signs are direct and consistent: A37's successor changed from A22 to the four new activities, each new activity is followed by A22, the lag between A37 and A22 increased from one to two steps, and the new activities are mutually exclusive and non-repeating. The number of qualifying evidence items (29) far exceeds the 0.41 expected by chance under a stable process. A competing explanation — that these activities are merely rare variants appearing in the later sample — is weakened by the coherent relational and positional pattern, though it cannot be fully excluded because the before window shows zero participation for these activities. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL004, REL005, REL008, REL009, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, LAG001, POS005]

The evidence: many items, all with high empirical strength. Screening: 82 units tested, expected 0.41 items by chance. We have many items (OCC001-004, DIR001-005, POS001-005, REL001-014, LAG001) - that's 4+5+5+14+1 = 29 items. That's many times the expected 0.41. So count is many times larger, cannot be explained by chance as a whole. So we proceed to judge.

The pattern: In the before window, activities A14, A15, A20, A21 were absent (participation 0). In the after window, they appear: A14 in 61/200 (30.5%), A15 in 51/200 (25.5%), A20 in 42/200 (21%), A21 in 46/200 (23%). They never repeat (recurrence 0). They appear at positions around 0.33-0.42 of the trace (early-ish, about a third through). They all precede A22 (DIR: A14->A22, A15->A22, A20->A22, A21->A22; REL: A14 before A22, etc.). Also A37 previously went to A22 (DIR005 before: A37->A22 with 1.0), now A37 goes to A14, A15, A20, A21 (with shares 0.305, 0.255, 0.21, 0.23) and no longer to A22. LAG001: A37 to A22 lag was 1 step before, now 2 steps. So the structure: before, A37 -> A22 directly (lag 1). After, A37 -> one of {A14,A15,A20,A21} -> A22 (lag 2). So a new intermediate step inserted between A37 and A22, choosing among four activities.

This is a structural change: insertion of a new activity (or a choice among four new activities) between A37 and A22. Direct evidence: DIR005 shows A37's outgoing transitions redistributed from A22 to the four new activities. REL004/005 etc show A14 before A22, A14 after A37 (B_before_A for A14,A37 means A37 before A14). LAG001 shows lag from A37 to A22 increased from 1 to 2.

So supported hypothesis: a new step (one of A14, A15, A20, A21) was inserted between A37 and A22 in the later window.

Count of items: 29 vs expected 0.41 - many times larger. So not chance.

Support level: Supported hypothesis.

Also note: A22 still present in all traces (support 1.0 both windows). A37 present in all traces (support 200 both). The new activities appear in about 21-30% of traces each, never together (cooccurrence 0 between them - REL001, REL002, REL003, REL006, REL007, REL010 show A_only and B_only, no cooccurrence). So they are mutually exclusive alternatives.

Positions: mean around 0.36-0.37, i.e., about a third through the trace.
